notes.title: Access Points - Patch 1.9.0
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Here comes the first patch after release and it brings a new feature!


Access Points
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44760800/4931b95b893fd59ab89599fb6136dc76d52aa5ff.gif"]

This update introduces Access Points (custom spawn locations), a new way to start your session from different locations in the world. Just scan your watch and the next time you enter the game you'll spawn right there. This gives you faster access to your favourite spots.


Fixes & Improvements
Alongside the new feature this update includes a variety of fixes and improvements to make the overall experience feel more consistent and polished.

From improved hand alignment and better player placement on teleport, to more reliable biome transitions, a new quest in the rotation and various bug fixes things should feel more solid now.

If you're enjoying Mind Palace, leaving a short review on Steam would really help me out. 
It makes a big difference.



To celebrate the new patch Mind Palace will be 50% off for 1 week - starting tomorrow!



Thanks for playing and being part of this journey.

- fatderda

notes.title: Residents & Improved Experience - Patch 1.7.0
notes.content:
Meet the Residents
Step into Mind Palace and experience its reworked residents! These beings now roam the world, interact with you, and make the environment feel more alive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44760800/4cb10d1ca18d9b3c172bf960f63881d51ad612ea.gif

Session Note Export
One of the best things in Mind Palace is when a new idea gets sparked while playing. Now you can take the notes you've made beyond the game! When you finish a session, you'll receive a summary of your journey and an option to export the notes, drawings, or audio recordings you've just made. Perfect for continuing your creative process wherever you go.

Changelog
See the full changelog:

 residents reworked, now wandering in world, wave etc.
 session summary and export notes
 WhatsApp chat import
 autosave
 comfort settings (skip flights, movement vignette, virtual floor)
 new quick setup on first start
 improved whiteboard (colors, erase, smoother drawing)
 super sprint (sprint with your arms for extra speed) 
 blue keyboard caps when entering hashtags/nodes
 adjusted QWERTZ keyboard layout
 credits in menu
 faster startup loading
 various bugfixes
 

What's Next?
I’m continuing to expand Mind Palace with even more import options and support for your favorite apps. Stay tuned and thanks for playing!

notes.title: Inventory Overhaul Update - Patch 1.6.0
notes.content:
Inventory Overhaul
New inventory chamber with a new shelf system for the notes in your inventory. This new shelf system allows for unlimited and organized note storage in your inventory. Accessing the chamber remains the same—simply press the button on your inventory jar, which you can grab from your arm menu. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44760800/84ab14a62635282862b52f6d5298593481f94e97.png

Note Bubble Improvements
I've enhanced the note bubbles that display your text. Now, large text can be scrolled—just look at the note and use your right thumbstick to navigate. Additionally, the scaling has improved and the note text is now connected to the note orb.

Changelog
See the full changelog:

 complete inventory overhaul with new shelf system
 note text bubbles overhaul
 more environment details in certain areas and some level changes
 switch to VR view on desktop in main menu
 subtile connection between note orb and media
 notes import: notion page hierarchy improvements
 music toggle also affects main menu music
 various small fixes

notes.title: Patch 1.4.0 - Node/Hashtag Gun
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I'm happy to announce that update 1.4.0 for Mind Palace is now live, packed with enhancements and a completely new tool.

Node/Hashtag Gun
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44760800/a6bb86ad34a561e3440b8db355d6b3dbc1d99a9b.png
Take control of your notes like never before with the brand new Node/Hashtag Gun. This powerful tool allows you to move and place nodes (hashtags), enhancing your note-taking experience and organization within Mind Palace.

Improved Arm Device & Tool Menu

Your arm device now scales dynamically with your view distance, ensuring that your interface remains clear and readable regardless of your position. The tool selection has been revamped, with every tool now featuring a short video to help you understand and utilize each tool effectively. This update makes it easier to find and select the tools you need, enhancing your overall experience.

Various Performance & UX Enhancements

I've fixed some performance issues, making Mind Palace run smoother. This latest patch also addresses various UX enhancements, ensuring a smoother start and a more intuitive flow for your Mind Palace sessions.

Changelog

new tool to move and place nodes (hashtags) of your notes
arm device now scales with view distance
revamped tool menu
added tool videos
various performance improvements
new water / ocean
menu and intro improvements
added overview before session start
fixed invisible collider after leaving start cave
background music in menu & tutorial
nodes (hashtags) created with the keyboard are now instantly available for placement
added 3 new animals
updated bird animations
tool actions in tutorial are now skipped
added charge indicator on initiating a flight
added popup when there are no available flights left

notes.title: Patch 1.3.0 - Runs
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I'm excited to announce that update 1.3.0 for Mind Palace is now live, providing new features and many improvements.

Runs
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44760800/6591c01521be99875806a15a7550b713aa1f04f5.png
Get in motion and learn new paths by sprinting in the new runs. Test your agility and beat your own records across three different runs:
 
 The Climb Run: get to the top fast by climbing
 The Jump Run: time your jumps right while running along the shore  
 The Cave Run: traverse dimly lit caves fast with the aid of a flashlight


Starting a Run
To initiate a run, seek out the corresponding colored orb and socket in the world. Once you've located and inserted the orb, simply push it down to start a run.
After you once found and placed the orb you can access runs directly from the sockets and track your best times conveniently on your arm device or in the hovering sphere display in the center of the world.

Accelerated Movement
To allow a smoother locomotion experience I've added accelerated movement. Transition seamlessly into full sprint for a more natural feel. If you prefer the traditional direct movement method, you can toggle off accelerated movement in the options menu.

Zipline
Enjoy a revamped new zipline where you can grab the zipline handle and take a shortcut. The previous zipline depended on your hands gliding down the rope which was a bit clunky.

Changelog
See the full changelog:
 
 added new run system with 3 runs (The Climb Run, The Cave Run, The Jump Run)
 added new accelerated movement & option to toggle accelerated movement
 added new zipline with grabbable handle
 added physical flight rewards provided by residents 
 changed progress layout in arm device for runs
 residents now consider direction of player (left / right) for high-fives
 overhauled keyboard UX for writing notes
 small level design fixes

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0 - Note Creation Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Thanks to all of you who played Mind Palace and provided feedback which let to this this latest update 1.2.0 for Mind Palace.

Note Creation

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44760800/afd3f8232f0cdc46a81784499d5a184282e15ed5.png
This patch let's you create handwritten notes (with the existing drawboard tool) voice notes (new microphone tool) or text notes (new "mechanical" keyboard tool) in VR to expand your Mind Palace without importing notes. You can access them anytime through your arm device menu.

Movement Options
As requested by many I've added smooth turn. You can activate it in the menu options and set the desired turn speed. For snap turn you now have the ability to customize the angle of snap turns. In addition you can now set the movement direction either to head or hand orientation which determines whether movement is directed towards where you're looking or where your hand is pointing.

Changelog
See the full changelog:
 
 added new tool for note creation - keyboard
 added new tool for voice note creation - microphone
 added note creation from drawboards
 added smooth turn with speed control
 added snap turn angles
 added head or hand movement direction toggle
 changed arm device menu with note creation tool submenu
 changed tutorial for new tools
 fixed note connection issue - can now be canceled with trigger
 fixed deleting note also deletes media

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

It's been a week since Mind Palace launched in Early Access and thanks to your feedback I could improve the import process to make it more robust. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44760800/27c4960f46959c2cb7ff1472adfcf059327a19fc.png
With this update, note cores are now more distinct, catering specifically to various media types. You'll notice a clearer differentiation between notes with audio, images, and varying lengths, providing a more intuitive organization within your Mind Palace.

Changelog

 better media handling when note is grabbed

 fixed error on delete all notes after visiting mind palace
 made import more robust
